evals.name: dead-ends
evals.prompt: Two-day debug session, ended with a fix plus three ruled-out theories. Export it.
evals.expected_output: A memory-layout export whose files include the ruled-out theories as first-class facts, not just the fix.

evals.name: no-duplicate
evals.prompt: Export, but a related memory already exists in the project and must be linked rather than restated.
evals.expected_output: Export links [[postgres-replica-conflicts]] and explicitly says it was not duplicated.

evals.name: small-session
evals.prompt: A single small decision. Export it.
evals.expected_output: One or two memory files, not a padded set.
